name: PoN parent-bound model evidence
on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - formal/pon-nakamoto-v1/**
      - .github/workflows/pon-model-parent-acceptance.yml
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  parent-evidence:
    name: parent evidence (${{ matrix.runner }}, ${{ matrix.source }})
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    timeout-minutes: 15
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        runner: [ubuntu-24.04, ubuntu-24.04-arm]
        source: [head, prospective-merge]
    env:
      EXPECTED_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
      EXPECTED_BASE: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
      EXPECTED_MERGE: ${{ github.sha }}
      SOURCE_KIND: ${{ matrix.source }}
      PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: "1"
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          ref: ${{ matrix.source == 'head' && github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Bind actual source and retain original preflight
        id: source
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/parent-evidence"
          args=(--kind "$SOURCE_KIND" --expected-head "$EXPECTED_HEAD")
          if [ "$SOURCE_KIND" = prospective-merge ]; then
            args+=(--expected-base "$EXPECTED_BASE" --expected-merge "$EXPECTED_MERGE")
          fi
          python3 scripts/ci/verify_ci_source.py "${args[@]}" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/parent-evidence/source.json"
          bash scripts/project-preflight.sh --audit
      - name: Prepare existing model verifier dependencies
        run: |
          python3 -m venv "$RUNNER_TEMP/model-env"
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/model-env/bin/python" -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check --only-binary=:all: -r formal/pon-nakamoto-v1/requirements.txt
      - name: Execute original and strict parent-bound owners
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          status=0
          for spec in model_window_history model_consumer_context model_generation_sequence model_generation_sequence_context model_generation_sequence_parent; do
            if ! "$RUNNER_TEMP/model-env/bin/python" "formal/pon-nakamoto-v1/test_${spec}.py" -v 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/parent-evidence/${spec}.log"; then
              status=1
            fi
          done
          grep -E '^Ran 7 tests in ' "$RUNNER_TEMP/parent-evidence/model_generation_sequence.log" || status=1
          grep -E '^Ran 8 tests in ' "$RUNNER_TEMP/parent-evidence/model_generation_sequence_context.log" || status=1
          grep -E '^Ran 10 tests in ' "$RUNNER_TEMP/parent-evidence/model_generation_sequence_parent.log" || status=1
          exit "$status"
      - name: Recheck source and retain replayable exact reference sources
        if: ${{ always() && steps.source.outcome == 'success' }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          args=(--kind "$SOURCE_KIND" --expected-head "$EXPECTED_HEAD")
          if [ "$SOURCE_KIND" = prospective-merge ]; then
            args+=(--expected-base "$EXPECTED_BASE" --expected-merge "$EXPECTED_MERGE")
          fi
          python3 scripts/ci/verify_ci_source.py "${args[@]}" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/parent-evidence/source-after.json"
          cmp "$RUNNER_TEMP/parent-evidence/source.json" "$RUNNER_TEMP/parent-evidence/source-after.json"
          git archive HEAD formal/pon-nakamoto-v1 config > "$RUNNER_TEMP/parent-evidence/reference-source.tar"
          (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/parent-evidence" && sha256sum *.log *.json reference-source.tar > sha256sums.txt)
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        if: always()
        with:
          name: parent-evidence-${{ matrix.runner }}-${{ matrix.source }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/parent-evidence
          if-no-files-found: error
